title: CRISPR screens identify genes essential for in vivo virulence among proteins of hyperLOPIT-unassigned subcellular localization in Toxoplasma (Unassigned_2)
model: Toxoplasma gondii RH, Unassigned_2 gRNA library (295 genes, 2,949 guides)
contrast: In vivo (9 mice) vs in vitro P4 reference, depletion; median-ratio totals
paper_method: Median log2FC fitness score, Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene, ranked by distance from regression line
paper_calls: Named/validated in vivo virulence genes (TgRimM, TBC6, DnaJ, CPSF, EFG1, and hypotheticals 300220/312840/277870/250790/221640/273905)
barcs_calls: 157 genes at FDR 0.10; no control null (no non-targeting guides)
named_hits: 11/11 at FDR 0.10, most in the top 22
verdict: BARCS recovers all eleven in vivo virulence genes the paper names or validated at FDR 0.10 (TgRimM #2, most within the top 22); the nine mice give 8 residual df so the standard model applies, though the single in vitro reference is unreplicated and the bottlenecked libraries require median-ratio totals.
